description: Comprehensive reference hardware profile demonstrating all supported interface types and topology matching options.
_comment_host_management: OPTIONAL: Dedicated physical management port reserved strictly for host OS. If omitted, management is virtualized over br-mgmt/mgmt0.
_comment_wan: REQUIRED: Primary WAN interface bound to vfio-pci and passed through directly to the router VM. Supports pci_bdf, pci_path, vendor, and device.
_comment_lan_options: LAN interfaces support: Option 1 (Single USB), Option 2 (Single PCI), or Option 3 (Multi-Port PCI array via lan_ports).
_comment_option_1_usb_lan: Option 1: Single USB Ethernet adapter identified by physical USB port path.
_comment_option_2_single_pci_lan: Option 2: Single PCI Ethernet/SFP port passed through to VM.
_comment_option_3_multi_pci_lan: Option 3: Multi-NIC array for multi-port enterprise gateways. Each port is passed through to the VM as eth1, eth2, etc.
